game.title: Los Angeles Rams at Philadelphia Eagles

lede: Los Angeles Rams carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#3 in EPA per play), while Philadelphia Eagles owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#6 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Philadelphia Eagles +0.9 with a fair total of 45.3 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Philadelphia Eagles pass offence vs Los Angeles Rams pass defence, which sits −0.042 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
